description: Get international legal basis (EU regulations/directives, AU conventions) for a Ghanaian statute. Returns all international instruments that the Ghanaian statute implements, references, or draws from, including GDPR, EU Directive 95/46/EC, Malabo Convention, and Budapest Convention references. Example: Data Protection Act 2012 → references EU Directive 95/46/EC and GDPR (Regulation 2016/679).

document_id.description: Ghanaian statute identifier (e.g., "act-843-2012") or title (e.g., "Data Protection Act 2012")

include_articles.description: Include specific article references in the response (default: false)

reference_types.description: Filter by reference type (e.g., ["implements"]). Omit to return all types.

name: get_eu_basis
